We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have a template 733 that does sulfonamide formation from aryl sulfonyl chloride (Cl-SO2-aryl) and an aniline (NH2-aryl). The retro template: product (aryl sulfonamide) -> reactants: aryl sulfonyl chloride + aniline.

Our target has a sulfonamide linking two aryl groups: left aryl is p-methyl aniline (para-methyl phenyl attached to N). Actually left side: Cc1ccc(N... )cc1 (para-methyl aniline). Right side: sulfonyl attached to another phenyl with a side chain: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl.

Thus retrosynthesis step 1: break sulfonamide to give aryl sulfonyl chloride (Cl-SO2-aryl) where aryl is the right phenyl (with side chain) and aniline (left phenyl with methyl). So we need two precursors: left aniline (p-toluidine) and right aryl sulfonyl chloride.

Check buyability: p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) is buyable (True). Right sulfonyl chloride: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc2ccccc2N)cc1 is not buyable (False). So need to synthesize that sulfonyl chloride in <=2 more steps (total 3 steps). Could make sulfonyl chloride from corresponding sulfonic acid or from sulfonylation of phenol? Typically aryl sulfonyl chlorides can be made from sulfonation of benzene then chlorination? But we need to keep side chain.

Alternative: use sulfonylation of the right phenyl with SO2Cl2? Actually sulfonyl chloride can be made from sulfonic acid (ArSO3H) via thionyl chloride. So we could make the aryl sulfonic acid via sulfonation of the phenyl (with side chain) using fuming sulfuric acid (SO3). That might be a step.

But maybe easier: use a different retrosynthetic disconnection: break the amide bond (C=O) linking the side chain to aniline? Actually the side chain is C=O attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). That's an amide linking to an aniline (para-aminobenzamide). Could break that amide to give an acid (cinnamic acid derivative) and aniline. However the target has the amide attached to the right phenyl side chain (the cinnamoyl anilide). The amide is attached to the right phenyl side chain (the cinnamoyl). So we could disconnect amide: give cinnamic acid derivative (with phenyl) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). That aniline is para-aminobenzene (aniline). That is buyable. The acid could be made from the phenyl with side chain? Actually the acid is (E)-3-(4-...?) Wait: The side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. So the acid is (E)-3-(4-sulfonyl phenyl)acrylic acid? Actually the sulfonyl phenyl is attached to the double bond: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl. So the acid would be (E)-4-(sulfonyl phenyl)but-2-enoic acid? Let's parse: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 is a phenyl with a para-substituted (maybe) side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2 attached at para position. So the acid precursor would be (E)-4-(4-(sulfonyl phenyl)phenyl)but-2-enoic acid? Actually the double bond attaches to phenyl at para position: phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2. So the acid is phenyl-CH=CH-COOH (cinnamic acid) with sulfonyl phenyl attached to the phenyl ring. So we could make that acid via Heck coupling of aryl bromide with acrylic acid? Or via Wittig? Might be complex.

Alternative route: keep sulfonamide step as final step (makes sense). Need to synthesize aryl sulfonyl chloride precursor. Could we get it from commercially available sulfonyl chloride? For example, 4-(chlorosulfonyl)phenyl with side chain? Not likely.

Maybe we can break the sulfonyl chloride into sulfonylation of phenol? Another route: use sulfonylation of aniline with sulfonyl chloride (like p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) but our sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl with side chain, not simple.

Thus maybe better to break the sulfonamide later, but we could also break the double bond? Could we use a different disconnection: break the C=C double bond via retro-aldol? Not typical.

Given limited time, propose a 2-step route: Step 1: Form sulfonamide from p-toluidine and aryl sulfonyl chloride (which we will synthesize in step 2). Step 2: Synthesize aryl sulfonyl chloride from corresponding sulfonic acid via thionyl chloride. Step 3: Synthesize sulfonic acid via sulfonation of the phenyl with side chain using fuming sulfuric acid (SO3). The phenyl with side chain (the right aryl) is commercially available? Let's check buyability of that phenyl with side chain (without sulfonyl). SMILES: c1ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc2ccccc2N)cc1 (no sulfonyl). Let's test.
